company_profile.tagline: Empowering Global Commercial & Industrial Energy Storage Systems
company_profile.description: We engineer and manufacture next-generation LFP battery energy storage systems (BESS) and smart microgrid control solutions to accelerate global zero-carbon transition.

style_requirements.custom_notes:
网页整体采用大面积留白与呼吸感，段落行高（line-height）设为 1.8；

部分卡片背景使用半透明毛玻璃特效（background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); backdrop-filter: blur(10px);）；

首页数字指标块（如 100+ GWh, 50+ Countries）需要有放大的数字排版，突出业绩规模。
